alignments.note: Waw of the consecutive form rendered by the connective *Then* (rule 14); the verb takes the verb.
Finite verb with its English subject pronoun (rule 17), headed on the lexical verb (rule 24).
Preposition בְּ → *in*.
Noun *ears*; the suffix takes its own pronoun under rule 18.
1cs suffix → possessive *mine* (rule 18).
קוֹל is an adverbial accusative; the supplied *with* belongs to the noun that licenses it (rule 33), and the indefinite *a* belongs to the same nominal expression (rule 15). Headed on *voice*.
Attributive adjective → *loud*.
The לְ of לֵאמֹר has no English realization (rule 27).
Infinitive construct → *saying*.

The imperative קָרְבוּ is recast causatively as *Cause ye ... to draw near*; the light verb *Cause* and its frame join the verb's discontinuous unit (rules 25, 44) and the head stays on the lexeme-bearing *draw*, since *cause* alone causes anything. The ASV's marginal *Draw ye near* would give the same unit a contiguous rendering; the printed text is what is aligned (rule 38).
Anarthrous substantive rendered *them that have charge*; the supplied antecedent and relative join its unit (rule 46), headed on the lexeme-bearing *charge*.
Article on the rectum takes the *the* standing before its own word (rule 29).
The construct relation is recast with *over*; that relational expression belongs to the nomen rectum (rule 19), headed on *city*.
The ASV writes no connective before *every man* (rule 14, final clause).
Distributive אִישׁ → *every man*.
Adverbial accusative of accompaniment; the supplied *with* belongs to the noun that licenses it (rule 33). Headed on *weapon*.
Nomen rectum rendered attributively (rule 28) → *destroying*.
3ms suffix → *his* (rule 18).
Preposition בְּ → *in*; the ASV writes no copula for this verbless clause, so nothing further is placed.
Noun *hand*.
3ms suffix → *his* (rule 18).

review_notes: The marginal *Or, Draw ye near that etc.* affects only the shape of s010's rendering, not the units; the printed ASV text governs (rule 38).
Both כְּלִי phrases (here and in v. 2) take the supplied *with* on the noun as an adverbial accusative under rule 33 rather than leaving it added.
